confidence_rationale: Influential, well-replicated demonstration that an intrinsic-curiosity bonus solves sparse-reward tasks vanilla A2C cannot, which supports the viability of the unsupervised-explorer path. Marked mixed rather than supports because the same line of work exposes curiosity's structural fragilities (the noisy-TV problem; dependence on the inverse-dynamics feature space) that make it an unreliable universal fix -- exactly the uncertainty the H-optim leg must resolve. Confidence tempered by Atari/VizDoom-to-REE transfer.
failure_signatures: The forward-model prediction-error bonus is attracted to inherently unpredictable stimuli (the 'noisy-TV' problem): an agent can be trapped maximising curiosity at a stochastic source instead of exploring task-relevant structure.

Curiosity is only useful to the extent the inverse-dynamics feature space captures action-controllable variation; if the learned features miss the task-relevant degrees of freedom, the bonus does not guide exploration toward the goal.
Demonstrated on VizDoom and Super Mario; sparse-reward success is task-structure-dependent and does not guarantee in-budget success on an arbitrary new environment such as REE forage.

mapping.source_claim_statement: An Intrinsic Curiosity Module -- a forward dynamics model whose prediction error in an inverse-dynamics-learned feature space is used as intrinsic reward -- lets an A3C agent explore and learn in sparse- and no-extrinsic-reward settings where a reward-only agent fails, solving tasks in under 100M frames that vanilla A2C failed to solve in 500M.
mapping.ree_translation: A second, well-cited instance of the unsupervised-explorer path: an intrinsic signal derived only from the agent's own experience can drive competent action learning under sparse reward, on top of a policy-gradient actor-critic. Supports keeping 'better explorer' as a MECH-457 build target, but the paper's own caveats (noisy-TV, feature-space dependence) argue that an intrinsic bonus is not a guaranteed fix -- consistent with the possibility that a scaffold/imitation teacher is still needed for REE.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Curiosity's success is contingent on the environment having learnable, action-controllable structure that its features capture; REE forage may or may not satisfy that. The 'mixed' direction is deliberate -- this entry both supports the explorer path (it works where vanilla RL fails) AND flags why it may not be sufficient (structural fragility), leaving the H-optim leg as the arbiter.
mapping.source_context: Deep RL, VizDoom navigation and Super Mario Bros., A3C actor-critic with an ICM intrinsic reward, pixel observations.

confidence_components.notes: High venue/citation weight. Mapping fidelity moderate: the mechanism (intrinsic bonus over an actor-critic) maps cleanly to the H-optim leg, but the demonstrated environments differ from REE. Transfer risk raised by the documented failure modes that could bite in REE forage.
